content: Hey Michael! I noticed you like hiking too. Have you been to Muir Woods recently?
Hi Emma! Yes, I was there last weekend actually. The redwoods are amazing this time of year.
That sounds wonderful! Would you want to do a hike together sometime?
I would love that! How about this Saturday morning?
Hey Emma, love your photos! Are you into landscape photography?
Thanks James! Yes, mostly landscapes and food photography. I saw you are an architect - that is so cool!
Thanks! I love how photography and architecture share that eye for composition.
Hi Michael! I see you are into board games. Have you tried Wingspan?
Wingspan is one of my favorites! Do you play often?
Every Sunday with friends! You should join us sometime.
Hi James! Fellow nature lover here. Your surfing photos look amazing!
Thanks Olivia! Do you surf too or are you more of a hiker?
Hey David! I love that you cook Thai food. What is your signature dish?
Definitely my green curry. I spent a month in Thailand learning from locals!
That sounds incredible. I would love to hear about your trip!
Hi Ryan! I see you are a marathon runner. I have been thinking about training for one.
You should go for it! The San Francisco Marathon is great for a first one.
Any training tips? I can run 5K comfortably but a marathon seems daunting.
Hey Ben! I love trivia too. What is your best category?
Science and pop culture are my strongest. How about you?
History and music! We should team up at trivia night.
Hi Ethan! Your bio made me laugh. What kind of fish do you usually catch?
Mostly trout in the Sierra. Sometimes bass at local lakes. Ever been fishing?
Once as a kid! I would be open to trying again with a good teacher.
David! Another rock climber! Indoor or outdoor?
Both! Just started lead climbing outdoors. You?
Same! We should hit Castle Rock sometime.
Ryan, I noticed we both like quiet evenings. What are you reading right now?
Just started Piranesi by Susanna Clarke. Highly recommend it!
Hey Ben! Your profile says you are a nurse. That is amazing work.
Thanks Olivia! Being a vet student is equally amazing. How is Biscuit?
James! Your architecture work looks beautiful. Sustainable design is so important.
Thank you Lisa! I would love to see your photography portfolio sometime.
Michael, what kind of music do you play on guitar?
Mostly indie rock and some classical fingerpicking. Do you play any instruments?
Hey Ryan! Fellow runner here. What is your marathon PR?
Alex, I love that you are a teacher and coach! What age group do you work with?
High schoolers! They keep me young. What kind of environmental science do you do?
Michael! A fellow tech person. What kind of software do you work on?
Mostly backend systems. I hear you are a data scientist - what tools do you use?
